items.goal: Authorize payment retries without duplicate capture.
items.acceptance: The retry and timeout suite records zero duplicate captures across at least 1,500 cases.

items.goal: Keep checkout responsive at launch traffic.
items.acceptance: p95 confirmation latency is at most 1,800 ms at 400 requests per second, and a 2x burst recovers within 60 seconds.

items.goal: Rollback the cutover inside one operator window.
items.acceptance: The prior release is restored within 12 minutes with zero payment-ledger drift.
